open-source-projects.purpose: A home for ImamTech Labs open-source projects, with a live hub that helps contributors discover projects and beginner-friendly tasks.
open-source-projects.setup: No build step. Serve the repository as static files; see the README.

mahmah-naturals.purpose: A real-world cosmetics storefront with product discovery, a shopping bag, WhatsApp order handoff, and a Supabase-backed owner dashboard under active development.
mahmah-naturals.setup: Run python -m http.server 8000 from the repository folder. See the MahMah Naturals README for the WhatsApp order flow, Supabase setup requirements, tests, and deployment notes.
